ideas.title: The $11 Million Medicaid Fraud Case: What Went Wrong?
ideas.description: Investigate the details of the $11 million Medicaid fraud case in Minnesota and the defendant's disappearance.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the defendant's connections to other entities or individuals involved in the scheme.
questions: What were the details of the fraud scheme?
How did the defendant manage to evade capture?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring attention to the issue of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota.
